item.title: Leadership shakeup at major benefits association
item.description: Jessica Brooks Woods, the outgoing chief executive, has been a longtime advocate for healthcare access. The post Leadership shakeup at major benefits association appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The fallacy of treating AI agents as fellow employees
item.description: To the extent that there is anything to the idea of treating an agent like an employee, it is only this: The agent has to be supervised. The post The fallacy of treating AI agents as fellow employees appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Where are all the laid-off workers going? Business formation data has answers
item.description: New business formations held at record levels as the new year kicked off. Here's what the data tells HR execs about workforce shifts in 2026. The post Where are all the laid-off workers going? Business formation data has answers appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: New 2027 ACA draft rules are out. 8 predictions about the impact
item.description: Jeff Smedsrud says that the draft Affordable Care Act individual health insurance market rules will make individual major medical insurance more attractive and more affordable in many markets. The post New 2027 ACA draft rules are out. 8 predictions about the impact appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: When will AI take your job? This tool thinks it knows
item.description: A new free calculator uses research from Goldman Sachs, Gartner and WEF to predict when AI will eliminate specific jobs by role. The post When will AI take your job? This tool thinks it knows appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Sam Altman isn’t panicking about AI taking jobs. Plus, industry news
item.description: AI anxiety is everywhere, but Sam Altman and Yale's jobs data agree: The disruption isn't here yet. But that doesn't mean HR can rest. The post Sam Altman isn’t panicking about AI taking jobs. Plus, industry news appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The fix for compliance: Culture, tech and accountability
item.description: Only one in three orgs are effectively using data analytics to evaluate compliance, suggesting HR needs to move from merely reporting metrics to extracting insight. The post The fix for compliance: Culture, tech and accountability appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: The ‘invisible pay cut’ of return-to-office
item.description: A new report finds that mandatory full-time RTO policies are adding almost six weeks of commuting time for employees—a loss of $8,158 per employee annually. It's an impact that experts say could affect productivity, performance and, ultimately, retention. The post The ‘invisible pay cut’ of return-to-office appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Healthcare jobs account for over half of U.S. job gains in January surge
item.description: Hospitals, clinics and home health services lead hiring, offsetting weaker gains in other industries. The post Healthcare jobs account for over half of U.S. job gains in January surge appeared first on HR Executive.

item.title: Build, buy, borrow or bot? Making faster, smarter workforce decisions
item.description: Too often, workforce decisions are improvised, debated repeatedly or revisited after execution is already underway. The post Build, buy, borrow or bot? Making faster, smarter workforce decisions appeared first on HR Executive.
